deep_screens.title: Dashboard and captured traffic
deep_screens.anatomy: Three-tier workspace: source hierarchy at left; request table across the upper work area; paired request and response inspectors below; protocol filters and capture controls in the toolbar.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Select a source, narrow the traffic table, then select a request to inspect both sides without leaving the window.
deep_screens.reference_value: Persistent context around a dense operational table; directly relevant to Brama request routing and traffic inspection.

deep_screens.title: Request/response overview
deep_screens.anatomy: Classic three-column layout: source list, flow list, and selected flow content, with the current selection preserved across columns.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Progressive selection moves left-to-right from scope to event to detail.
deep_screens.reference_value: A clear master-detail hierarchy for large event collections.

deep_screens.title: Custom previewer tabs
deep_screens.anatomy: Compact modal sheet with available tabs, enabled tabs, drag handles, and destructive reset/remove actions.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Users tailor inspector tabs while preserving a small, focused configuration surface.
deep_screens.reference_value: User-controlled information density without exposing a full settings window.

deep_screens.title: Horizontal request/response layout
deep_screens.anatomy: Full-width request and response panes arranged side-by-side under the traffic list.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Parallel comparison keeps corresponding request and response fields visible simultaneously.
deep_screens.reference_value: Useful when comparison matters more than vertical reading depth.

deep_screens.title: Vertical request/response layout
deep_screens.anatomy: Request and response panes stacked vertically beside the flow list.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Sequential reading gives each payload more horizontal room and keeps the request before the response.
deep_screens.reference_value: Useful for long headers, JSON, and code-like content.

deep_screens.title: Workspace panel controls
deep_screens.anatomy: Small toolbar cluster controls source-list visibility, detached inspector windows, and horizontal or vertical inspector arrangement.
deep_screens.interaction_model: One-click layout changes alter the workspace without navigating away from active traffic.
deep_screens.reference_value: Compact control placement for configurable multi-pane products.

deep_screens.title: Body previewer
deep_screens.anatomy: Inspector tab with formatted body content, view-mode selector, export action, and open-with application menu.
deep_screens.interaction_model: The active payload stays visible while secondary actions are exposed contextually.
deep_screens.reference_value: A strong pattern for keeping raw evidence primary and tools subordinate.

deep_screens.title: JSON tree view
deep_screens.anatomy: Split inspector with hierarchical JSON tree, path/value details, and context actions anchored to the selected node.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Expand, search, select, and copy structured payload fragments without converting views.
deep_screens.reference_value: Tree-based inspection for nested model responses and API metadata.

deep_screens.title: Multiple filters
deep_screens.anatomy: Filter builder above the request table, composed from multiple typed criteria joined with AND/OR.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Users add, clone, reorder, remove, and keyboard-navigate criteria while results update in place.
deep_screens.reference_value: Scalable filtering beyond a single search box.

deep_screens.title: Breakpoint rule
deep_screens.anatomy: Focused rule sheet with URL matching, request/response toggles, rule options, and one primary creation action.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Configuration is prepared before interception; defaults are populated from the selected request.
deep_screens.reference_value: Safe setup surface for high-impact routing or mutation rules.

deep_screens.title: Breakpoint request/response editor
deep_screens.anatomy: Modal editor presents request and response content with editable URL, status, headers, and body plus explicit abort/cancel/execute actions.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Traffic pauses at the breakpoint until the operator modifies or releases it.
deep_screens.reference_value: A strong model for consequential edits with explicit continuation.

deep_screens.title: Breakpoint raw HTTP editor
deep_screens.anatomy: Raw HTTP editor concentrates the full message in one code-like text surface, with execution controls separated at the edge.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Advanced users edit protocol text directly and then explicitly execute or abort.
deep_screens.reference_value: Progressive disclosure: structured editor for most users, raw mode for experts.

deep_screens.title: Map Local rule editor
deep_screens.anatomy: Rule editor combines request matching with editable response status, headers, body, and local-file substitution.
deep_screens.interaction_model: A captured response seeds the rule, reducing setup effort and preserving realistic defaults.
deep_screens.reference_value: Reusable pattern for turning observed data into a deterministic override.

deep_screens.title: Map Local from response
deep_screens.anatomy: Context menu attaches Map Local directly to the selected request in the traffic table.
deep_screens.interaction_model: A local rule begins from the object already under inspection rather than from an empty global form.
deep_screens.reference_value: Contextual creation is faster and less error-prone than detached configuration.

deep_screens.title: Diff side-by-side
deep_screens.anatomy: Request selector above two synchronized comparison panes with line-level additions and removals.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Users choose left and right flows, scan aligned differences, and retain traffic context.
deep_screens.reference_value: Best comparison mode for structurally similar payloads.

deep_screens.title: Diff unified
deep_screens.anatomy: Single unified diff stream beneath the request selector, using conventional red/green change encoding.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Users follow one chronological change narrative and can export or comment on it.
deep_screens.reference_value: Compact evidence presentation when horizontal space is limited.

deep_screens.title: Compose request editor
deep_screens.anatomy: Standalone request editor with method and URL header, request tabs, editable payload, response inspector, and a dominant Send action.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Compose, send, and inspect the result in one persistent workspace.
deep_screens.reference_value: A complete task-focused tool window with immediate feedback.

deep_screens.title: Opening Compose
deep_screens.anatomy: Compose is exposed as a primary toolbar action inside the traffic workspace and also through the application menu.
deep_screens.interaction_model: The tool is reachable from both pointer-first and menu/keyboard workflows.
deep_screens.reference_value: Dual discoverability for important expert actions.

deep_screens.title: Compose JSON body
deep_screens.anatomy: JSON body editor occupies the main pane while request metadata remains in tabs and response output stays adjacent.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Users edit structured input, send, and compare output without context switching.
deep_screens.reference_value: Directly relevant to model request playgrounds.

deep_screens.title: Compose raw message
deep_screens.anatomy: Raw-message tab replaces field forms with one protocol-level editor while retaining the surrounding request workflow.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Experts can paste or author complete HTTP messages without losing Send and history controls.
deep_screens.reference_value: Advanced mode contained inside the same task model.

deep_screens.title: Compose templates
deep_screens.anatomy: Compact template popover lists empty, GET, JSON, form, multipart, and cURL starting points.
deep_screens.interaction_model: A template initializes meaningful fields while leaving the resulting request fully editable.
deep_screens.reference_value: Small preset menu that accelerates common cases without becoming a wizard.

deep_screens.title: Import cURL
deep_screens.anatomy: Import surface accepts cURL input and translates it into the normal Compose workspace.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Paste-driven import turns an external representation into editable native state.
deep_screens.reference_value: Useful pattern for interoperability and low-friction migration.

deep_screens.title: Compose request history
deep_screens.anatomy: History popover overlays the Compose window with prior requests while preserving the current editor behind it.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Selecting a prior request restores it into the active composition workflow.
deep_screens.reference_value: Local recency and reuse without a separate history screen.

deep_screens.title: Command palette
deep_screens.anatomy: Centered search palette overlays the current app, groups matching commands, and exposes pinning for recurring actions.
deep_screens.interaction_model: Keyboard invocation, incremental search, and immediate execution bypass deep menus.
deep_screens.reference_value: High-value navigation pattern for expert desktop applications.

deep_screens.title: Automatic certificate setup
deep_screens.anatomy: Guided setup sheet separates Automatic and Manual modes, explains the trust operation, shows live status, and offers one dominant install action.
deep_screens.interaction_model: The preferred path performs installation and confirms Installed & Trusted in the same surface.
deep_screens.reference_value: Good model for prerequisite setup with visible completion state.

deep_screens.title: Manual certificate setup
deep_screens.anatomy: Manual setup tab presents numbered steps, certificate generation controls, Keychain handoff, and verification guidance.
deep_screens.interaction_model: The alternative path remains available without diluting the recommended automatic route.
deep_screens.reference_value: Progressive disclosure for privileged or exceptional setup.

deep_screens_note: Twenty-six official screens cover capture and inspect, inspector configuration, inspector layout, workspace customization, payload inspection, filtering, interception and rules, local mapping, comparison, request composition, command navigation, and onboarding and trust.
